items.author: mysticgames-in.bsky.social
items.context: Fishing games are the best cozy break between action ones. Waiting for the bite is oddly close to waiting for a parry window. Which one hooked you first?
items.text: Stardew Valley's fishing is a gentle one: you keep the bar on the fish and the pace stays calm, which makes a nice break between busier games.

items.author: youryanderegf.yuri.living
items.context: I think ive made peace with being an older gamer. people always give me grief for not wanting to play stressful games but like life is stressful enough I just want to play something cozy
items.text: Nothing wrong with that at all. Unpacking is a good fit for a stressful day: no timer, no fail state, just calm little tasks.
items.verify: Проверить: в Unpacking нет таймера и проигрыша.
